question: In January 2025, in which city did the NDRF launch a rescue operation after a boat capsized?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Varanasi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **January 2025**, a boat capsize incident occurred in the **Ganges** river in **Varanasi**, **Uttar Pradesh**, prompting an immediate rescue operation.
 
• The **National Disaster Response Force (NDRF)**, specifically the **11th Battalion** stationed in **Varanasi**, was deployed to conduct the search and rescue mission.
 
• The incident took place near one of the prominent **Ghats** of **Varanasi**, where local boat traffic is high due to the arrival of numerous **pilgrims** and **tourists** during the winter season.
 
• The **NDRF** utilized specialized equipment, including **deep-sea divers** and **Inflatable Motor Boats (IRBs)**, to navigate the currents of the **Ganga** and locate survivors.
 
• Such operations in **Varanasi** are critical as the city sees a massive influx of visitors for religious ceremon
